title: Text Generation
description: Send a prompt, get a response—no extra configuration needed. AInvoker abstracts away multiple AI providers into one unified interface, giving you reliable text generation with less code and zero vendor lock-in.

title: Image Generation
description: Create images with a single request while AInvoker abstracts away provider-specific APIs. Control prompts, size, and output format through a consistent interface designed for reliability and flexibility.

title: Action Invocation
description: Trigger real-world actions through a unified interface. AInvoker lets you invoke application logic—like sending emails, processing data, or running workflows—without building custom integrations. Define actions once, and let AInvoker handle execution, validation, and scaling behind the scenes.
